meta.title: Theme Box
meta.description: Manage themes, opening animations and desktop pets in DSH.

title: Theme Box
failed: The operation could not be completed. Please retry.
DESKTOP_COMPONENT_MISSING: This package is missing the desktop component for this platform.
DESKTOP_READY_TIMEOUT: The pet did not become ready. Please retry.
DESKTOP_LAUNCH_FAILED: The desktop component could not start.
note: Disabling this plugin or quitting DSH also stops the pet.
source: Character assets: PC2005-cloud / dsh-pet. Non-commercial personal use.
authorization: Shared activation-code licensing will be added after desktop validation.
DESKTOP_ARCHIVE_INVALID: Desktop component verification failed. Reinstall the development package.
DESKTOP_EXTRACT_FAILED: The desktop component could not be unpacked. Reinstall the development package.
activationIntro: Activate once for both the startup animation and desktop companion.
offlineActive: Offline access remains valid. Refresh when online.
activationSuccess: Activation succeeded. This device is licensed.
packIntro: Switch the startup animation, pet clips and behavior together.
packMaterialNote: Demo packs use bundled public assets. Import using a new pack ID.
desktopOpeningIntro: After quitting, open DeepSeek Harness from its icon to play the opening.
launcherIntro: Open DSH Companion Launcher to see the animation before DSH and the pet.
STARTUP_NOT_REGISTERED: Apply the skin and enable its startup content before previewing.
STARTUP_NATIVE_UPDATE_REQUIRED: Update the desktop component to use this startup content.
unbindWarning: Unbinding stops companion features and releases the device slot. A connection is required.
updateAvailable: The service channel offers a newer version. An update is available.
updateInstructions: To update or reinstall the same version, add the downloaded package in DSH's plugin manager and enable it. Quit DSH normally, then reopen it. Your license and settings are retained.
recoveryIntro: Re-enable the plugin from the DSH plugin list to restore your license and settings.
CLIENT_UPDATE_REQUIRED: Update Theme Box before activating this license.
PLUGIN_DISABLE_FAILED: Could not disable the plugin. Try again from the DSH plugin list.
HOST_WINDOW_INVALID: Could not read the DSH window size. Reopen the Theme Box panel.
launcherRemovalNote: Open DeepSeek Harness from its icon. You can remove the old launcher here.
channelOlder: The channel version is older. No update is needed; keep your installed version.
channelSame: The channel and installed versions are the same. No update is needed; download only to reinstall.
checkUpdateFirst: Check the service channel version first.
downloadHistoryNote: These are previously saved files, not an update recommendation. Do not replace the installed version with an older package.
UPDATE_DOWNGRADE_BLOCKED: The channel package is older than your installed version. Downloading it as an update is blocked.
skinInstallCancelled: Selection cancelled. The library and current selection are unchanged.
skinAlreadyInstalled: This content is already installed. Your selection and preferences are retained.
skinInstalled: Skin added to the library. Choose Apply Skin to switch.
REPLY_STYLE_SESSION_MISSING: Open a session before turning on its reply style.
REPLY_STYLE_INVALID: Enter a tone and check the length of the address and tone.
skinResetComplete: Default settings restored for this skin.
skinApplyMissingFiles: Skin files are missing. Import the complete ZIP again or apply a different skin.
skinInstallFailed: Installation did not finish. Check skin.json at the ZIP root and its declared resources, then retry.
SKIN_ZIP_REQUIRED: Select an ordinary ZIP skin package.
SKIN_ZIP_INVALID: Could not read this ZIP. Check that the file is complete.
SKIN_ZIP_PATH_INVALID: The ZIP contains unsupported relative paths. Check its contents.
SKIN_TOO_LARGE: The skin package exceeds the current resource size limits.
SKIN_MANIFEST_INVALID: The ZIP root must contain a valid skin.json.
SKIN_RESOURCE_MISSING: A declared resource is missing. The skin was not installed.
SKIN_RESOURCE_HASH: A resource hash does not match. The skin was not installed.
SKIN_RESOURCE_SIZE: A resource size does not match. The skin was not installed.
SKIN_LIBRARY_INVALID: The local skin library record is invalid. Preserve the files and report this issue.
SKIN_LIBRARY_FULL: The local library has reached its current package limit.
PET_ACTIVITY_NOT_READY: Enable work feedback and actions, then open an idle conversation and try again.
SKIN_SETTINGS_SHARED: 本机还有这套皮肤的其他版本，请卸载所有版本后再清除设置。
SKIN_CLEANUP_UNCONFIRMED: 未能确认效果已停止，皮肤文件已保留，请重试卸载。
SKIN_CATALOG_INVALID: 皮肤库数据校验失败，请刷新重试。
SKIN_PACKAGE_MISMATCH: 下载包与皮肤库记录不一致，请重新下载。
SKIN_DSH_UNSUPPORTED: 这套皮肤尚不支持当前 DSH 版本。
SKIN_VERSION_CONFLICT: 这套皮肤的相同版本已有不同内容。
SKIN_DOWNLOAD_LIMIT_REACHED: Skin download limit reached. Acquired skins can still be reinstalled and updated.
SKIN_CATALOG_QUERY_INVALID: 搜索条件无效，请调整后重试。
SKIN_DOWNLOAD_PAUSED: 正在切换授权，请稍后重新添加下载。
SKIN_DOWNLOAD_LICENSE_CHANGED: 授权已改变，请重新添加此下载。
